transformations.headline_yoy: quarterly average of chained monthly headline index versus same quarter one year earlier

transformations.fx_and_external_prices: 100 times log change in quarterly-average level versus same quarter one year earlier
transformations.division_contribution: current-year official division weight times division YoY log change
transformations.reconciliation_residual: headline YoY log change minus sum of 13 weighted division log changes
